exposure: Women with spondyloarthritis and without childbirth
Women without spondyloarthritis and without childbirth
Women without spondyloarthritis and with childbirth
outcome: Bone marrow edema of sacroiliac joints
finding: Pregnancy/childbirth was not associated with long-term bone marrow edema on sacroiliac joints, but may cause long-term subchondral sclerosis, similar to spondyloarthritis-associated sclerosis.
mod_finding: Birth method did not have a significant effect on sacroiliac joint sclerosis.
